name: becmi-foundry
description: Foundry VTT v13+ system for BECMI / Rules Cyclopedia, verified on v14

scripts.extract: node tools/extract-all.mjs && node tools/normalize-compendia.mjs && node tools/repair-spell-index.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run sources && fvtt package pack -n monsters --id becmi --type System --in source/monsters --out packs && fvtt package pack -n spells --id becmi --type System --in source/spells --out packs && fvtt package pack -n equipment --id becmi --type System --in source/equipment --out packs && fvtt package pack -n classes --id becmi --type System --in source/classes --out packs && fvtt package pack -n treasure --id becmi --type System --in source/treasure --out packs && fvtt package pack -n tables --id becmi --type System --in source/tables --out packs && fvtt package pack -n journals --id becmi --type System --in source/journals --out packs
scripts.verify: node tools/validate.mjs && node tools/test-data-models.mjs && node tools/test-integrations.mjs && node tools/test-encounters.mjs && node tools/test-treasure.mjs && node tools/test-sheets.mjs && node tools/test-character-creation.mjs && node tools/test-character-wizard.mjs && node tools/test-rc-rules.mjs && node tools/test-spell-index.mjs && node tools/test-monsters.mjs && node tools/verify-packs.mjs monsters spells equipment classes treasure tables journals
